script: Marketplaces bring clients, payments and reviews, but they also charge fees and have strong competition. Build a clear profile, with a headline that says what you do and for whom. Write proposals that show you read the brief. Early reviews matter a lot. Now the warnings: never move a conversation off the platform before hiring. Never pay a fee to receive work. Never share your password or verification codes. Only trust payment once the money has cleared.
